The path defines a closed shape with four vertices: (56,84), (63,84), (63,51), (56,51).  
These points form vertical and horizontal lines:  
- Top edge from (56,84) to (63,84) — horizontal, length 7  
- Right edge from (63,84) to (63,51) — vertical, length 33  
- Bottom edge from (63,51) to (56,51) — horizontal, length 7  
- Left edge from (56,51) to (56,84) — vertical, length 33  

Opposite sides are equal and parallel, all angles are 90°, so it is a rectangle.  

Final answer: (H)
